reviews.title: Great keyboard, software is finicky, after setup it's a dream.
reviews.comment:
I got this cause I needed a wireless, smaller keyboard for my desk. I can't believe I only paid 100 dollars for this.
Features:
-This uses a bluetooth dongle and has the option of connecting via bluetooth. That can be helpful if you're switching between your main computer which is connected via dongle and your laptop (or something) that is connected via bluetooth. The switch is instantaneous as well.
-Has a low profile volume wheel on the edge of the keyboard as well as some low profile skip/pause/mute controls on the upper right
-fully customizable RGB. I keep it to audio responsive solid red w/ cyan cause it looks cool. It has an LED indicator for both the battery and caps lock.
-Comes with that old android style of USB cable (USB Micro). The cable that I got with the purchase was not functional for updating the keyboard, however it did work to charge it. I did have to use an old cable I had lying around to actually get it to update. The issue was when updating, the update button would be greyed out and it took some simple troubleshooting to figure out I just needed to try different USB Micro cables rather than the one supplied. This was the thing that ultimately got the update button to show up.
-VERY good battery life. I just keep a coiled charging cable nearby and charge it whenever it needs it. My only complaint here is I would prefer the modern USB Type C charging cable.
-Keys are low profile and I've grown to prefer this style over the full sized keycaps. I like not having to press the keys so far for the keystroke to register.
reviews.author: Koalten

reviews.title: Quality product.
reviews.comment:
Awesome, crisp clicks. Keys come off for cleaning which I love. Rgb light colors are customizable and it syncs with the Logitech mouse.
I wish the keyboard and mouse worked with usb c instead of mini usb. But I can’t complain. The crisp keys and customizable settings make up for everything. Although it doesn’t require making up for much. I like the size and weight. It is heavy and feels quality.
reviews.author: jimboyrulez

reviews.title: It's great, only one thing to keep in mind.
reviews.comment:
This thing has an old usb I think its micro usb. Also, kinda miss having a number pad. These are things that bother me; for the price point, I should shut my mouth.
MULTIPLE DEVICE PAIRING: I have a tower, a laptop, and a Mac Mini. This keyboard comes with a dongle; it also has a Bluetooth button for pairing. You will have no problems with 2 devices, one via dongle and one paired Bluetooth. If you have a 3rd, your not going to be happy; you have to pair this 3rd device every time, and that's not easy seeing as I need my keyboard to get into the settings menu.
reviews.author: Pierce

reviews.title: Great keyboard half the price
reviews.comment: Great looking and feeling keyboard. I’m not expert but feels nice and sturdy. Really easy to set up just plug in the usb dongle. Nice clicky sound when typing. Very compact and space saving. Charged it for about an hour and it’s already lasted about 2 weeks and still at 74%. The leds are nice and bright and easy to change with the free software
reviews.author: luis

reviews.title: Apprehensive about "renewed" products, but great experience so far.
reviews.comment:
I was slightly apprehensive about buying a "renewed" or refurbished product after reading a few of the reviews that mention malfunctioning keys, missing parts, or outright an outright broken product.
It seems my fears were unwarranted (though time will tell regarding longevity). I received the keyboard in adequate time. It was well packaged, and delivered to the specified area. It arrived in its factory box, with all of it requisite components, all still factory wrapped.
The keyboard connected to my PC without event, and after a brief firmware update, all of the functions work as advertised, and all seems well. Its very well made, has a reassuring amount of weight, with little to no flex in the keyboard, or keycap wiggle. LED lighting is nice and bright, with more than enough brightness options should the default brightness prove too intense.
The inbuilt lighting modes are all fascinating, and the per-keycap lighting options are loads of fun to play with. The typing experience is very satisfying, and the low profile of the keyboard itself lends itself to very little wrist discomfort. The included feet on the keyboard should help with any deviation in this.
All-in-all, I am very satisfied with my purchase.
reviews.author: David
